title: Portable Page Metadata (frontmatter)
description: Frontmatter vocabulary for a page in the Portable Wiki Markdown profile. See guidelines/09-Metadata_and_Frontmatter.md and Appendix C. Deliberately permissive: known keys are type-checked, unknown keys are allowed and should be preserved.

id.description: Stable identifier surviving renames. UUID recommended; engine identifiers prefixed with a scheme, e.g. mw:20481.

aliases.description: Other titles that resolve to this page, including former titles.

redirect.description: Target title or path when this page exists only to redirect.

tags.description: Free-form labels; hierarchy flattened as parent/child.

kind.description: page (default), category, template, help, system, discussion, user, redirect; other values allowed.

translations.description: Map of BCP 47 tag to page path or title.

status.description: draft, wip, stable, deprecated, archived, deleted; other values allowed and preserved.

visibility.description: Advisory signal for importers; not an access-control model.

license.description: SPDX identifier or expression, or a URL.

source.description: URL of the page in the exporting wiki.

format.description: Media type of the body, e.g. text/markdown; charset=UTF-8; variant=GFM.

properties.description: Free-form structured data. Page references as [[Title]] strings; dates as RFC 3339.

schema.description: URL or bundle path of a JSON Schema describing properties.

about.description: Subject page of a kind: discussion page.

ext.description: Engine-specific data namespaced by engine name.

datetime.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with offset or Z, or a bare YYYY-MM-DD date.
